question: What does the property map actually tell me?
guardrails: Do not state that a registry map conclusively establishes the exact physical boundary unless a legally conclusive boundary entry applies.
Do not substitute general Tailte Éireann boundary datasets for a Land Registry folio/title plan.
Do not infer ownership from a map.
Do not infer planning permission, building compliance or physical occupation from the title plan.
If the question concerns an easement or right of way, inspect the relevant folio/instrument and any applicable map evidence.
